resources.string: Your keyboard will light up in the dark and switch off in bright light. Finish the quick setup below, then tap Enable.
Setup is done. Tap Enable NightKeys below.

This phone is not supported yet
NightKeys is made for the Titan 2 Elite on Android 16, used by the phone’s main user. Nothing on this phone has been changed.
Right now: dark (%1$.0f lux). Keys light up.
Right now: bright (%1$.0f lux). Keys stay off.
Keys light up when it’s darker than %1$.0f lux.
Slide left: only in very dark rooms. Slide right: lights up sooner.
3 quick steps. You only do this once.
A free helper app that lets NightKeys control the keyboard light, without rooting your phone.
Open Shizuku and tap Start. First time? Shizuku shows you how to pair over Wi‑Fi. Our guide explains every tap.
Tap Allow NightKeys, then choose “Allow all the time” in the Shizuku pop-up.
Almost done. Connecting to the keyboard light…
Couldn’t reach the keyboard light. Tap Try again.
Access was declined. Tap Allow NightKeys and choose “Allow all the time”.
You’re all set. Tap Enable and close the app.
Automatic lighting is on. It continues when you leave the app.
Turn back on after Shizuku restarts
After a phone restart, open Shizuku and tap Start, then open NightKeys.

This copies model, firmware, light readings, keyboard timeout and connection status to your clipboard. Nothing is uploaded. Review it before posting publicly. It does not include typed text or a device serial number.
Report copied. Review it before sharing.
Before uninstalling, clearing app data or stopping Shizuku, tap Stop & restore. If the app is killed unexpectedly, a keyboard setting can stay changed. This beta has no independent watchdog.
